method: CUA native accessibility actions and visual screenshot inspection

cases.observed: Nine candidates, wrong answer, hint, clear and correct multi-selection; all controls visible.
Correct total but excess five-yuan stock rejected; both genuine legal payments accepted.
First-layer check left whole activity incomplete, with 0 attempts and 1 check. Wrong cell located, clear/undo restored state, full pyramid accepted. Check count persisted after process restart.
Nine unique rectangles marked; reversed duplicate did not increment. Reviewed first rectangle, undid 9 to 8, re-added 9, submitted count 9 successfully.
Fold directions, retained paper area and red holes visible. Hint plus empty submit kept controls visible; correct pattern accepted.
Red-correct/blue-wrong option C rejected; both-correct option B accepted.
A rotated 90 degrees and placed; B filled the lower-left cell; completed arrangement and controls fit the window.
Sixteen-cell board and reference visible together. Blue and explicit blank cards placed; undo restored an unfilled cell.
A-D-B-C-F was legal but too long. A-B-E-F completed in three segments and was accepted.
All four food-preparation atlas frames, labels, reference and ordering surface rendered correctly.
Four frog-growth frames and all three parent steps visible, with the main action in the same window.
Four independent cat-plant frames. Step 6 accessible. Empty observation submit rejected; two supported/one notYet selections survived mode switches, clear and undo; save succeeded.
Three matching connections aligned with endpoints and reference table. Unlink and right-side-first reconnection worked; complete answer accepted.
Required local listening disabled answers while playing; choices appeared after playback. Replay entered listening again and incremented repeat count.
Observation showed four object/count associations (4,5,6,7). Cue disappeared before response; all four recalled pairs accepted.

notes: All observation selections and successful answers in this acceptance run are technical QA, not real child samples. The earlier 621-page browser pass covers initial pages; native acceptance covers the cases above.
